intent: Individually authored teen-number reading tasks with a labelled ruler, exact additional-jar units and bounded count manipulation. Guided practice only; no independent or hearing credit.
picturePurpose: An original whole jar is repeated only by code to represent additional jars; exact counts never come from generated arrangements.

workshop.title: 先圈单位，再算总数与剩余
workshop.instruction: 摆出题目所问的数量；原例句仍按自己的语境填词。

items.label: eight：八支队伍，首轮几场
items.prompt: Eight teams enter the first round. Each team plays once, with two teams in each match. How many matches are needed?

wordDecision.prompt: Eight teams enter the first round. Each team plays once, with two teams in each match. How many matches are needed?

quantity.title: 给首轮摆比赛卡
quantity.hint: 一张卡代表一场；每场两队。
quantity.wrong: 八队、两队一场，应摆4张比赛卡。

items.material: Eight teams entered the school tournament.
items.reason: eight teams表示八支队伍，four matches表示四场比赛。本题限定每队在首轮只打一次，不能按循环赛计算。an eight-team tournament中的eight以元音音素开头，team作修饰语用单数。

options.reason: 八是队数，不是场数；每场有两队。
八队分成四对，不是六场。
八队，两队一场，每队在本轮只打一次，共四场。

items.label: nine：人数和组数分开
items.prompt: Nine pupils will work in groups of three. How many groups are there?

wordDecision.prompt: Nine pupils will work in groups of three. How many groups are there?

quantity.title: 摆出分好的小组
quantity.hint: 一张卡代表一组，不是一名学生。
quantity.wrong: 九人、每组三人，应摆3张小组卡。

items.material: Nine pupils volunteered to clean the pond.
items.after: pupils volunteered to clean the pond.
items.reason: nine pupils用复数pupils，表示九名学生；the ninth pupil是第九名学生，ninth去掉nine末尾的e。本题问组数，用9÷3，不是9−3。

options.reason: 九人，每组三人，共三组。
九是人数；并非每人单独一组。
这里要分组，不是从九里减去三。

items.label: ten：十厘米是距离，不是种子数
items.prompt: The first seed is at 0 cm on the ruler. Put the second seed 10 cm away. Which mark should it reach?

wordDecision.prompt: The first seed is at 0 cm on the ruler. Put the second seed 10 cm away. Which mark should it reach?

ruler.title: 把第二粒种子的标记放到正确刻度
ruler.hint: 起点在0 cm；先核对两粒种子之间的距离。
ruler.wrong: 从0 cm量起，间隔10 cm，第二粒种子应在10 cm刻度。

items.material: Leave ten centimetres between the seeds.
items.reason: ten centimetres表示十厘米的距离。两粒种子之间只有一个间隔；若三粒分别在0、10、20厘米处，就有两个十厘米的间隔。刻度由题目给出，不用屏幕上的实际长度代替厘米。
items.hint: 从0 cm量到10 cm；两个端点之间是一个间隔。

options.reason: 从0到9只有九厘米，少了一厘米。
从0厘米到10厘米，相隔十厘米。
从0到11有十一厘米，多了一厘米。

items.label: eleven：到公园之前还剩几站
items.prompt: There are eleven stops before the park. The bus has passed three of them. How many of those stops remain?

wordDecision.prompt: There are eleven stops before the park. The bus has passed three of them. How many of those stops remain?

quantity.title: 摆出公园前还没经过的站点
quantity.hint: 每张卡代表尚未经过的一站；不含公园站。
quantity.wrong: 十一站中已过三站，还剩8站。

items.material: The bus has eleven stops before the park.
items.reason: eleven stops before the park表示公园站之前有十一站，不包括公园站。本题已过其中三站，剩11−3=8站。原例句说总数，仍填eleven。
items.hint: total 11 − passed 3 = remaining 8；不另算公园站。

options.reason: 这是原来的总数，没有扣掉已过三站。
这里只算公园前的站点；不能把公园站再加进来。
公园前共十一站，已经过三站，还剩八站。

items.label: twelve：容量和还要加多少
items.prompt: A box has twelve jar spaces. Nine jars are already inside. How many more jars fill all the spaces?

wordDecision.prompt: A box has twelve jar spaces. Nine jars are already inside. How many more jars fill all the spaces?

quantity.title: 只摆需要再加的罐子
quantity.hint: 每幅图是一只完整罐子；这里只摆还需加的数量。
quantity.wrong: 已有九罐，十二个位置还缺3罐；不要再摆十二罐。

items.material: The box holds twelve small jars.
items.reason: twelve jars表示十二罐；the twelfth jar表示第十二罐，twelfth不能写成twelveth。题目问more，应从总容量十二里扣掉已有九罐；图中只摆要加的三罐。

options.reason: 十二个位置已有九罐，再加三罐正好装满。
十二是总容量，不是还要加的数量。
九是已有的数量；再加九会超过十二个位置。

items.label: thirteen：删掉又加入，人数变了吗
items.prompt: A list has thirteen names. Two names are crossed out, then two different names are added. How many names remain?

wordDecision.prompt: A list has thirteen names. Two names are crossed out, then two different names are added. How many names remain?

recordSelection.title: 圈出便条写明的两次变化
recordSelection.prompt: 只圈实际发生的操作，不圈总数。
recordSelection.hint: 把先删、再加两步都找全。
recordSelection.wrong: 应圈Cross out 2 names和Add 2 different names。13 names是起始总数，不是一次变化。

items.material: Thirteen names are written on the list.
items.after: names are written on the list.
items.reason: thirteen是13，thirty是30；先看完整拼写，不能只看开头thir。名单先删两人再加另外两人，13−2+2=13。读题要把两个变化都接上。

options.reason: 只算了删去两人，漏掉后面新增两人。
十三减去两个，再加两个，仍为十三个。
只算了新增两人，漏掉前面删去两人。

items.label: fourteen：总数里分出后来找到的
items.prompt: Mei found fourteen shells in all: six in the morning and the rest later. How many did she find later?

wordDecision.prompt: Mei found fourteen shells in all: six in the morning and the rest later. How many did she find later?

quantity.title: 摆出后来找到的数量
quantity.hint: 每个扇形代表一枚贝壳；只摆后来找到的部分。
quantity.wrong: 全天十四枚中早上已有六枚，后来找到8枚。

items.material: She counted fourteen shells on the sand.
items.reason: fourteen shells表示十四枚贝壳；fourteen保留four的u，forty才去掉u。本题in all给总数，the rest问剩余部分，应用14−6=8。

options.reason: 十四是全天总数，不能把早上的六枚再算进后来。
早上的六枚已包括在总数里，不能用十四加六。
合计十四枚，早上六枚，后来找到十四减六等于八枚。

items.label: fifteen：总题数和未答题数
items.prompt: A quiz has fifteen questions. Lin has answered eleven. How many questions are still unanswered?

wordDecision.prompt: A quiz has fifteen questions. Lin has answered eleven. How many questions are still unanswered?

quantity.title: 摆出尚未作答的题目
quantity.hint: 一张卡代表一题；只摆未答的部分。
quantity.wrong: 十五题已答十一题，应摆4张未答题卡。

items.material: The quiz has fifteen short questions.
items.reason: fifteen是15，不能写成fiveteen；fifty是50。题目问still unanswered，先圈未答，再用十五减去已答十一，得到四题。这里的计数不等于正确率。

options.reason: 十五题中答过十一题，还有四题未答。
十五是总题数，不是剩余未答题数。
十一是已经答过的题数，正好和问题相反。

transfer.stem: Which summary follows the preparation note?
transfer.passage:
TOURNAMENT HELPERS — PREPARATION NOTE
Eight teams will play in the first round. Each team plays once, with two teams in each match. Nine pupil guides will work in groups of three. The display box has twelve spaces for jars, and nine jars are already inside. Our quiz has fifteen questions; Lin has answered eleven of them.

options.text: The first round needs eight matches, and the box needs three more jars.
The first round needs four matches, and the box needs twelve more jars.
The first round needs four matches, and the box needs three more jars.
The first round needs four matches, and the box needs nine more jars.

answer.display: The first round needs four matches, and the box needs three more jars.

explanation.strategy: 先核对单位，再区分总数与需要增加的数量。

steps.text: 八队首轮各打一次，每场两队，共8÷2=4场。
steps.reason: 两队共打一场；不能把队数直接当场数。

steps.text: 十二个罐位已有九罐，还需12−9=3罐。
steps.reason: 问的是more jars，要扣掉已有罐子，而非照抄总容量。

distractors.reason: 八是队数；两队一场，首轮需要四场，不是八场。
十二是总容量；已有九罐，只需再加三罐。
九是已有的数量，不是需要再加的数量。

explanation.pitfall: 同一便条里可能同时有总数、已有数和剩余数。先看所问的单位与范围。

visual.title: 分别核对场数和新增罐数
visual.caption: 队数不等于场数，容量不等于还需增加的数量。

explanation.transfer: 如果改为十队、每场两队，本轮需要几场？十二个罐位若已有十罐，还需再加几罐？
